goal: Assess the Phase 3B art candidate package for Godot integration feasibility, import prep needs, visual/collision alignment risk, and gameplay scope risk without mutating Godot or importing assets.
forbidden_changes: asset import, transparent sprite generation, crop cleanup, Godot scene mutation, Godot script mutation, project.godot mutation
final art direction, style bible, production asset approval, or public-release asset usage
movement changes, collision changes, HUD implementation, enemy, item, scoring, camera, web export, or gameplay expansion
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Assessment covers required implementation questions
verify.command: rg -n "Godot Target Mapping|Import Prep Needs|Visual Collision Alignment Risk|Gameplay Scope Risk|Asset-by-Asset Assessment|Excluded Implementation|Next Work Package Options" implementation_notes/IN-2026W22-001-phase3c-asset-integration-assessment.md

verify.name: No Godot or asset files changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(art_notes/AN-2026W22-003-art-production-capability-boundary.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-018.json|runs/RUN-20260531-001.json|art_candidates/phase3b/.*|art_notes/AN-2026W22-004-art-production-candidate-report.md|owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-003-phase3b-art-candidates-KR.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-019.json|runs/RUN-20260531-002.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-020.json|runs/RUN-20260531-003.json|implementation_notes/IN-2026W22-001-phase3c-asset-integration-assessment.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-021.json|runs/RUN-20260531-004.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

acceptance_criteria: The assessment maps each Phase 3B required_asset_id and candidate_id to a likely Godot integration target or explicitly marks it as not implementation-ready.
The assessment identifies import prep needs such as transparency, crop cleanup, scaling, file placement, and naming.
The assessment identifies visual/collision alignment risks for player, floor/platform, obstacle, and goal marker.
The assessment treats timer/HUD as visual reference unless a later UI-specific Work Package authorizes implementation.
The assessment flags any candidate that could expand gameplay scope.
The assessment proposes next Work Package options without authorizing Godot mutation.
No Godot files, asset files, schemas, agent profiles, owner reviews, QA reviews, or Learning Cards are changed.
notes: This Work Package is implementation-owned assessment only. It does not authorize asset import, transparent sprite generation, Godot changes, gameplay changes, final art direction, or production use.
